text: Even when the Self is manifest as the Self of the Lord of the Universe, the mere contemplation of that manifestation and the recollection of its attributes do not confer complete fullness in the state of separation. However, when, through the words of the Guru and so on, arises the contemplation of the supreme excellence of the Supreme Lord, characterized by omniscience, omnipotence, and so forth, then, at that very moment, the attainment of complete Selfhood is realized.
